init.title: StaggAssistant Options
init.description:
Adjust integration settings.

⚠️ **Notice on extended entities:** On firmware 1.2.26+, Fellow blocks reading device settings over Wi-Fi. Extended switches, sliders, and sensors (hold duration, chime volume, boil temperature, schedule, altitude) rely on local optimistic caching and estimates, and are hidden by default to avoid 'Unknown' states.
